summary: Comprehensive redesign plan to align Onit with the end user's feedback and attached curriculum PDF: (1) Replace the Home tab with an interactive Bank & Card Recommendation Survey plus interactive financial calculators, (2) Overhaul Modules into a 1-column high-level list -> Lesson selector -> bite-sized 1-line slide player using the exact C/P slides and question types (MC, T/F, SA, MT, DD, and timed Module 2 Badge Battle) from the attached PDF, and (3) Declutter Credit Cards and Banks with click-first category buttons and progressive disclosure (high-level cards first, full details on click).
